name: Science, Technology, Innovation (STI) and Sustainable Development
description: Sustainable development and the SDGs; historical perspective on processes of technology development to meet societal objectives; nature and dynamics of technological change; elements of innovation processes and perspectives on organizing for effective innovation (and role of key actors); case studies on role of STI in agriculture, health, energy, and environment; potential future role of STI in SD in India.
